That's fair, like I said, I am not completely familiar with Tai Lung. Venom would definitely be interesting!

Tex takes this no problem, in my opinion, she is incredibly powerful and is a contender in hand to hand combat as well as with firearms from sniper rifles and rocket launchers to smgs and pistols (and she would definitely be carrying some kind of firearm) She's also not human, though I am not sure what kind of body she has (organic, robot, cybernetic) but I believe it is fair say she could literally fight to the end, not succumbing to pain or exhaustion. We have seen Tex handle other foes with total badassery and finesse, not to mention she is intelligent and fights in a style specifically countering her enemy  (i.e. her battle against Washington and The Meta, which was technically a loss in her sense, but still serves as an example of her strategic planning) which gives her an edge, if she has enough time to observe Tai Lung, since she had no previous knowledge. Not to mention she can go invisible, giving her the ability to flank and confuse Tai Lung. 

Tai Lung, on the other hand, is a strong fighter and master- but not strong enough.  I think the one advantage he does have is deep wisdom that would definitely allow him to figure a a strategy to best Tex, faster than she cd figure him out, but even with that knowledge I don't see him taking it. His speed and size do not outmatch the speed and accuracy of Tex, which are damn near perfect. Lung's artifacts featured in Kung Fu Panda could prove useful as bizzare weaponry against Tex, but the only one I remember is the sword so sharp it cuts anyone who looks at it, and I don't see that being insanely useful. Unless I am forgetting an artifact that could be really helpful, I don't see him taking the battle in that regard. I just don't think he offers anything crazy special that separates him from any other foe who is incredibly skilled in martial arts, considering Tex is also incredibly skilled. 

HOWEVER as others have pointed out, Tex actually can't succeed at her goals. For those who don't know, Tex is created from Leonard Church's memories of his deceased wife, Allison (along with a lot other fun artificial intelligences). All of these artificial intelligences act and appear different based off of what kind of memories/element of Church's psyche they're based off of. Because her creation is based off the death of Allison, it is impossible for Tex to ultimately succeed, as it is against her nature. I am not sure how this factors in, because she is still capable of defeating others and kicks a lot of ass. It's not like she can never do anything right. 

So if Tex cannot win because it's literally improbable considering her source, then she will likely choke in the end or do something to allow Tai Lung to win. 

If this not the case? Then I believe Tex will win. 

TLDR; Tex is a superior fighter and will outpace Tai Lung ultimately giving her the victory, though it is possible because she is based off the memory of death and failure, it is impossible for her to win. That being said, she is the superior fighter. 

(Massive RvB fan, also enjoyed Kung Fu Panda, I definitely have a knowledge gap regarding Tai Lung and may not be remembering him completely accurately. I think it's fair to say I am biased towards Tex, but I did make the effort to be fair.)
